target_customer: Consumers and creators who make and play AI generated video content
problem: AI video tools made one-off clips with inconsistent characters. Eggnog lets creators design consistent AI characters, make cinematic scenes and remix characters from other users.
product_category: Consumer AI video and interactive entertainment

founders.name: Sam Plank
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built creator monetization tools at Quora that reached $1M ARR in under a year, and an AI assistant for podcasters.

founders.name: Jitesh Maiyuran
education: MIT, BS and MEng in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC page gives only the first name Jitesh; surname from a Launch HN reference in a search summary. Trained a model to generate music lyrics and worked on medical imaging models.

technical_complexity.rationale: Consistent characters across generated video scenes was an open problem in early 2024, but the team built on third party generative video models.

defensibility.rationale: Built on commodity generation models; a content network and character library could form over time but none was shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: General video model vendors kept adding consistency and social features; no response specific to Eggnog was found.

market_need_then: Generative video was newly viable in early 2024 and viral AI clips drew attention. The company says its top video reached 100k views on Twitter in 24 hours.

branding.domain_note: Uses eggnog.ai, an .ai domain; no purchase history found.

identity.mascot_or_character: User created AI characters are the core of the product
identity.voice_and_tone: playful, meme oriented; YC launch pitched it as YouTube for AI-generated content

branding.brand_signature: Consistent user designed AI characters in cinematic scenes
branding.community_and_virality: YC launch post says Paul Graham found a video funny and the top video had 100k views on Twitter in 24 hours (company statements).

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable seasonal word, but the name is generic and only directory listings and the launch post exist.

outcome_analysis: Eggnog is an active two founder YC Winter 2024 startup in consumer AI video. Aggregators report about 500K USD from YC and angels, and apps named Remix, Time Portal and Taffy appear in directories, but no traction data or later round was found. The outcome is unclear; the space is crowded with larger model vendors.
notes: Company website eggnog.ai returned only a title, so product facts come from the YC page. Aggregators (CB Insights, VCBacked, Extruct) report 500K USD convertible note dated 2024-04-04 from Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund and SBXi; stage labels and round counts conflict and none is primary, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Competitor list empty: only 2026 directory pages found. Founder surname Maiyuran comes from search summaries of a Launch HN post; location listed as New York by some sources.
